headlines.title: Is this the dot-com bubble again? Nearly $1 trillion gone
headlines.summary: AI stocks just had a brutal week, with nearly $1 trillion wiped off Google, Amazon and Intel even as Big Tech posted record cloud revenue. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down how the selloff started, who is paying for the AI buildout, and the bear and bull case for whether this is the dot-com bubble again or a correction.

headlines.title: Why investors are dumping tech stocks, in one image
headlines.summary: Tech stocks aren't getting shredded for any old reason. It's actually very fundamental: Free cash flow is drying up for Big Tech leaders, and capex is rising dramatically.

headlines.title: Cloud Numbers Are In; This Week the Spotlight Moves to Phones, Laptops and Chips
headlines.summary: Market Updates News Commentary - Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon reported third-quarter results last week, and the next-session moves in their shares ranged from a fractional dip to a double-digit drop. Attention now turns to consumer hardware: Apple holds its fiscal fourth-quarter results call this afternoon, and Qualcomm, whose largest revenue stream comes from handsets, reports on Wednesday. headlines.title: Marvell Plunges 13% on Lumentum Takeover Rumors: Make Your 3-5 Year Bet Right Now
headlines.summary: Acquisition rumors sent Marvell tumbling hard in a single week, but the real question for long-term investors is whether the chaos around a potential Lumentum deal hides a rare buying opportunity or a costly distraction from Marvell's AI roadmap.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
